subject: MAP: outcome definitions, smoke-test catalog & close tempo
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Narayan <priya@meditech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: outcome definitions, smoke-test catalog & close tempo

Hi Priya / Amit,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — quick follow-up with a compact mutual action plan draft attached. The goal: align on how MediTech will validate Redwood in a 3-week evaluation and what "done" looks like so procurement can sign quickly.

Highlights in the sheet (MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Week 1: Integration & minimal throughput smoke tests (connectivity, inference without errors)
- Week 2: QA scenarios + 5 core prompts per workflow for accuracy measurement (concordance target: >= 92% on the sample set)
- Week 3: Load sampling + latency SLO verification (p95 < 450ms under 10 rps) and final handoff artifacts

Also attached is a short smoke-test catalog (smoke_test_catalog.md) with the test names and acceptance thresholds. Key asks from your side:
1) Confirm the list of 5 representative prompts per workflow by EOD Friday (6/13)
2) Share a procurement contact and expected PO window so we can align trial terms
3) Confirm data handling requirements for the demo recording and whether a masked dataset is needed

If that timeline works, we’ll schedule a weekly 30-minute sync on Fridays to review evidence and blockers. I attached the demo from Tuesday (demo_20250609.mp4) — you can use it to verify end-to-end behavior.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), smoke_test_catalog.md (text), demo_20250609.mp4 (video)
From: Priya Narayan <priya@meditech.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amit Reddy <amit.reddy@meditech.com>
Date: 2025-06-11T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: outcome definitions, smoke-test catalog & close tempo

Thanks Rachel — this is helpful. A few quick notes after I reviewed the MAP_v1: 

- The 3-week window looks fine but can we front-load the data access/setup so Week 1 is only connectivity + small sample tests and Week 2 covers the larger QA runs? Our infra team prefers at least 48 hours of warm time before load testing.
- Concordance target: 92% is reasonable, but we need a fallback plan if we hit 88-91% (i.e., retune prompts + re-run sample set). Can you include a short remediation path in the MAP?
- Procurement contact: looping in our sourcing lead (Amit) — he’ll give the procurement timeline. Expect PO conversation to start the week of 6/23.

We’ll confirm representative prompts by Friday (6/13). For the demo video, please confirm that any PHI was redacted — we can only share masked screenshots internally.

Best,
Priya
Priya Narayan
Head of Platform Integrations, MediTech
priya@meditech.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Narayan <priya@meditech.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-06-13T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: outcome definitions, smoke-test catalog & close tempo

Priya — thanks for the quick review. I updated the MAP with a short remediation ladder and a revised schedule that front-loads setup windows. See the attached tab in MAP_v1.xlsx ("Remediation + Schedule"). Summary of changes below: 

- Setup window: We’ll schedule a one-hour infra kick (Zoom) within 48 hours of access being granted. Redwood will validate connectivity and KV caching behavior with a short checklist.
- Remediation ladder if concordance in sample set lands 88-91%:
  * Step 1: Prompt augmentation (2 business days) — Redwood will propose up to 3 prompt variants per workflow
  * Step 2: Quick quantization rollback (if enabled) — target same-day change to a higher-fidelity runtime image
  * Step 3: Re-run QA sample set and compare to baseline; if still below 88% we propose a controlled scope reduction for the pilot features
- Evidence expected for sign-off (final artifacts): prompt set with version tags, scoring spreadsheet (CSV), latency logs (perf p95/p99), and a short screencast showing classification paths

Ben — any comments on the latency targets? We kept p95 < 450ms at 10 rps; if we need to tighten we should call it out now.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Attachment referenced: MAP_v1.xlsx (Remediation + Schedule tab)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Narayan <priya@meditech.com>, Amit Reddy <amit.reddy@meditech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-06-18T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: outcome definitions, smoke-test catalog & close tempo

Great — appreciate the alignment. Recap and next steps to keep the MAP tight: 

- Priya to confirm representative prompts by 2025-06-13 (noted as confirmed in your last reply).
- Redwood to schedule infra kick within 48 hours of dataset/access (we’ll send calendar invites once access window opens).
- If concordance lands 88-91% we will run the remediation ladder; final sign-off requires >= 92% or documented agreement on scope reduction.
- Procurement: Amit to start PO conversation week of 6/23; Rachel to support with a short redline summary for legal if needed.

Can everyone confirm they’re OK with the revised MAP and the artifacts list so I can move the DocuSign link to final? If yes, I’ll mark the MAPv1 as the canonical evaluation plan and target a close window (either PO or explicit decline) by 2025-07-01.

Thanks,
Rachel
